seo.title: ODD — connecting Finland's creative and cultural fields
seo.description: ODD connects Finland's creative and cultural fields with business and wider society through events, spaces and projects in Helsinki.

hero.mosaicAlt: People, performances, talks and encounters from ODD in Helsinki.

opening.headline: ODD exists to connect Finland's creative and cultural fields with business and wider society.

whatOddIs.headline: Events, spaces and projects built for connection.
whatOddIs.body: ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace are three different ways of doing the same thing: getting people out of their usual circles. ODDfest brings independently made events across Helsinki into one shared week. ODDference puts creative expertise in the same room with business and society. ODDspace keeps the connection going year-round — a place to work, meet and collaborate. Different formats, same direction: more chances for people from different fields to find each other, learn from each other and build together.

twoWaysIn.intro: Creative people and businesses often move in different circles. ODD works in both directions: creating better conditions for creative work, and more ways for business to meet, learn from and work with the people behind it.

business.lede: Get closer to creative people and creative thinking.
business.body: ODDference brings business leaders into the same room with people working across art, culture and the creative fields. ODDnetwork, projects and partnerships create ways to keep those relationships going beyond the event.

creative.lede: Work, show and find your people.
creative.body: ODDspace gives you a year-round place to work, meet others and shape something together. ODDfest is a way to put what you're already doing on the map — host your own programme, reach new people and discover what others around the city are making.

whatsHappening.note: A running list of what's on across ODDfest, ODDference and ODDspace — updated as things are confirmed.

items.title: Coffee on the House
items.description: A standing open meetup for ODDspace members and friends, most weeks, in Vallila.

platforms.title: ODDfest
platforms.body: A city-wide creative week made by the people taking part in it. Artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies host their own programme; ODD brings it together into one shared whole.

platforms.title: ODDference
platforms.body: A professional event built around what business and wider society can learn from creative expertise — with people from those worlds in the same room.

platforms.title: ODDspace
platforms.body: A year-round home for people working across creative and cultural fields — with places to work, meet, host events, make things and shape the space together.

platforms.title: Work with ODD
platforms.body: Join the network, bring us a project or build a partnership with us.

workWithOdd.title: Work with ODD.
workWithOdd.intro: Come to ODDference, stay involved through ODDnetwork, bring us a project or build something with us from the start.
